info.title: Synthetic Universe Data APIs
info.description: Pay-per-call data APIs for AI agents via x402 ($0.01 USDC per call on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Solana). GET the endpoint, receive an HTTP 402 challenge, pay the quoted USDC, resubmit — data returns automatically after settlement. Operated by Synthetic Universe LLC.

get.summary: Get sun/moon rise-set times and moon phase for a date
get.description: Use when an agent needs sunrise, sunset, twilight, and moon phase for a location and date — photography planning, event scheduling, or radio operations. Pass lat, lon, and an optional YYYY-MM-DD date. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch TLS certificate details and expiry for a domain
get.description: Use when an agent monitors TLS certificates — its own infrastructure or a client's. Returns issuer, validity window, and days remaining so the agent can alert before expiry. Pass the domain. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch country facts: capital, currency, languages
get.description: Use when an agent needs reference data about a country — capital, region, income level, and coordinates to join against FX, holidays, or geocoding results. Pass the ISO code or the country name. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Country name, resolved to ISO. Example: United States

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch crypto spot prices for one or more coins
get.description: Use when an agent needs a live crypto spot price — pricing goods, portfolio math, or trading-bot inputs. Pass the symbol (e.g. BTC) and an optional 3-letter currency, default USD. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: 3-letter fiat code, default USD. Example: USD

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch OHLCV candles for a crypto pair
get.description: Use when an agent needs OHLCV candles for a crypto pair — charts, trading decisions, volatility checks. Coinbase Exchange data. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days of candles. Example: 30

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Candle interval: daily or hourly. Example: daily

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch batch crypto spot prices for multiple coins
get.description: Use when an agent needs batch crypto spot prices — portfolio checks, pricing, market snapshots. Multiple coins in one $0.01 call (Coinbase). Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Resolve DNS records for a domain
get.description: Use when an agent needs DNS records for a domain — verifying MX before sending mail, infrastructure recon, or pre-flight checks. Pass the domain and an optional record type. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Record type, default A: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS, SOA, SRV

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch latest entries from an RSS or Atom feed
get.description: Use when an agent needs an RSS/Atom feed parsed to clean JSON — news monitoring, content ingestion, or change detection. Pass the feed URL; up to 20 items, HTML stripped. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch fiat exchange rates against a base currency
get.description: Use when an agent needs a fiat currency conversion at current reference rates — pricing, payouts, or multi-currency accounting. Pass amount plus from/to currency codes. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Convert an amount between any two currencies
get.description: Use when an agent needs to convert an amount between any two fiat currencies — pricing, budgeting, cross-border math. Any base currency (ECB reference rates via Frankfurter), no base-currency lock. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch historical FX rates over a date range
get.description: Use when an agent needs historical fiat exchange rates over a date range — trends, backtesting, reporting. ECB reference rates via Frankfurter. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch live EVM gas prices for a chain
get.description: Use when an agent needs the current gas price on an EVM chain before sending a transaction — cost estimation, fee budgeting, or deciding whether to transact now. Pass network (base, polygon, arbitrum, avalanche); returns live eth_gasPrice plus priority fee in wei and gwei from the chain's public RPC. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: EVM chain id. Example: base (default), polygon, arbitrum, avalanche

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Convert a place name to latitude/longitude
get.description: Use when an agent has a place name and needs coordinates — the on-ramp to the weather, ISS-pass, and astronomy endpoints, which all take lat/lon. Pass q for forward lookup, or lat+lon for reverse. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place name for forward lookup. Example: Leander, TX

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: List public holidays for a country and year
get.description: Use when an agent needs to know whether a date is a public holiday in a country — support scheduling, market calendars, or posting logic. Pass the 2-letter ISO country code and an optional year. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Check HTTP status, timing, and headers for a URL
get.description: Use when an agent needs to verify a webhook or endpoint is alive — status code, redirect chain, key headers, and timing in one call. A down target returns an honest unreachable result instead of an error. Pass the URL. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full http(s) URL to check. Example: https://example.com/hook

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Fetch IP geolocation: city, region, country, ASN
get.description: Use when an agent needs approximate geolocation and network info for an IP — fraud triage, locale defaults, or log enrichment. Pass ip, or omit to look up the caller's own IP. City-level approximate. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Get upcoming visible ISS flyover times for a location
get.description: Use when an agent needs upcoming visible ISS flyover times for a location — skywatching alerts, photography planning, or space-event scheduling. Pass the observer's latitude and longitude. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Generate an original lyric line in ambient sleep-lane voice
get.description: Use when an agent needs an original lyric line in Brian Booms' ambient sleep-lane voice — short cosmic/comfort lines for creative prompts, app copy, or bedtime content. All lines are his own words (no third-party lyrics, no royalty issues). Rotates daily; pass index for a specific line. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Quote index 0-11, optional. Omit for today's rotating quote. Example: 7

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Run a one-call domain check: alive, DNS, TLS expiry
get.description: Use when an agent needs a one-call pre-flight check on a domain — is the endpoint alive, does DNS resolve, is the TLS certificate valid and when does it expire. Pass domain or full URL; one $0.01 call returns all three checks. A down target returns honest per-check results, not an error. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full URL instead of domain. Example: https://example.com/path

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Extract clean article text from a webpage
get.description: Use when an agent needs clean article text extracted from a webpage — navigation, ads, and chrome stripped for downstream processing or summarization. Pass the page URL. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Build a wind-down schedule for a city and bedtime
get.description: Use when an agent needs a wind-down schedule for a city and bedtime — real local sun times plus wind-down start and a 7.5-9h wake window, computed from live geocoding and astronomy. Pass city and bedtime HH:MM. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: bedtime
parameters.description: Bedtime HH:MM 24-hour, local to the city. Example: 22:30

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.summary: Get one practical sleep-hygiene tip
get.description: Use when an agent needs a genuine sleep-hygiene tip — one practical habit from Brian Booms' rotating collection of 12 (consistent wake times, light, wind-down routines; no medical claims). Rotates daily; pass index for a specific tip. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Tip index 0-11, optional. Omit for today's rotating tip. Example: 3

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details

get.description: Use when an agent needs a delayed equity quote — portfolio math, watchlists, or market context. Pass the ticker (bare US tickers get .US). Delayed ~15 min, not investment advice. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

parameters.name: symbol

get.description: Use when an agent needs the key points of a public webpage without reading the whole page — research triage, link previews, or content monitoring. Pass the page URL; robots.txt is honored before any charge. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

Computed locally from the time zone database, no upstream to fail. Pass tz. Resale permitted: buyer may resell this data output at their own price.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge with payment details
